description: This file defines the Transaction model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling customer transaction data including adding, deleting, retrieving, and summarizing transactions in the database.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Model class for managing customer transactions within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record in the database with customer ID, order ID, description, and amount.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes customer transaction records, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transactions associated with a specific order ID where the amount is negative.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction records for a customer, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions for a specific order.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of transaction amounts for a customer.
